info.title: Theatarr native API
info.description: Theatarr's own API (docs/design/web.md). Served at /api/theatarr/v1. Read-only apart from login (local and Plex), logout, API keys, the profile, users (admins), requests (create, cancel, approve, decline; docs/design/users.md), the anime metadata review (accept or reject an item), journal verdicts, the recovery actions (grab a release, remove, retry or unblock a download, remove a copy or title, unlink a file; managers; docs/design/ui.md "Recovery actions"), retrying and dismissing failed jobs, the import API (POST /import, behind the library gate) POST /titles/{id}/refresh (queues a TMDb metadata refresh), adds and version toggles (POST /titles, PUT /titles/{id}/versions/{key}), a movie's minimum availability and a series' type (POST /titles/minimum-availability, POST /titles/series-type; managers), search now (POST /titles/{id}/search: versions in mode active while router.enabled is true, never shadow ones), and season and episode monitoring and search (PUT /titles/{id}/seasons/{season}/monitor, PUT /titles/{id}/episodes/monitor, POST /titles/{id}/seasons/{season}/search, POST /titles/{id}/episodes/search: searches by the same rule). Title art is served from /img on this origin, outside this API. POST /decide only reads. Every route needs a session cookie or an X-Api-Key header unless marked otherwise, and the permission it names; a key carries its owner's permissions. 403 means the account may not do this. Session requests that change state need the CSRF token (X-CSRF-Token header), which /auth/login and /auth/me return.

x-arr-views.description: Arr-compatible endpoints are served separately at each configured view's /api/v3 base; their compatibility contract is documented in docs/design/arrview.md.
x-arr-views.notifications: GET /notification/schema and notification CRUD expose supportsOn/onHealthRestored, onSeriesAdd (Sonarr), onMovieAdded (Radarr), onRename and onManualInteractionRequired, plus includeHealthWarnings. Health/HealthRestored carry one changed check (level, message, type, wikiUrl); restoration carries the previous issue. SeriesAdd/MovieAdded announce each new title/version once. Rename carries renamedEpisodeFiles/renamedMovieFiles. ManualInteractionRequired announces each held download/reason once, with downloadInfo quality, downloadStatus and safe downloadStatusMessages. New events omit release and download-client details, including current and previous file paths, under the webhook privacy rule. Nothing sends unless notify.enabled.
x-arr-views.manualImport: GET/POST manualimport and the ManualImport command honour per-file quality/revision, languages, releaseGroup, indexerFlags and title/episode choices. Unknown quality/language and blank group fall back to parsing. Reprocessing recalculates formats and decisions; execution accepts explicit choices while retaining the sample guard and library gate. move, copy and auto create symlinks, retain source files, and journal the requested mode.
x-arr-views.seriesLookup: GET /series/lookup?term=tvdb:N reads uncatalogued series fields and default-order seasons through the existing TVDB/TMDb metadata gateway clients, cached five minutes (failures thirty seconds). Free text without a local match searches TVDB by name with type=series. The lookup is bounded to five seconds; metadata failure preserves the local answer (an id stub or empty name search). POST /series stores seasons[].monitored for later metadata refreshes.
x-arr-views.aliases: Movie and series ids are 1000000 plus Theatarr's title id in every view; an id a client kept from a replaced arr instance answers 404, so the client syncs again.
x-arr-views.deleteFiles: DELETE /movie/{id} and /series/{id} with deleteFiles=true checks every Theatarr link before changing anything; a closed library gate or refused path returns 409. Allowed links move to library trash before the view's versions are removed. deleteFiles=false leaves links. Imported arr files, mount content and provider data are never touched.
x-arr-views.queue: GET /queue pages expanded episode identities in SQL; each Sonarr episode has a stable queue id and pack members share downloadId. DELETE /queue/{id} or /queue/bulk removes the whole download or pending release for any member id; debrid content is retained. Default timeleft ascending places known estimates before unknown ones, with progress descending on ties. GET /queue and /queue/details emit timeleft and estimatedCompletionTime from up to six provider progress samples within five minutes. Ready/importing downloads report 00:00:00 and now. Unknown, flat, stale or reset progress omits both fields.
x-arr-views.paging: History, wanted/missing, wanted/cutoff, blocklist and queue select pages with SQL LIMIT/OFFSET and separate counts before hydrating resources. Defaults are page 1 and pageSize 10; nonpositive pages clamp to 1, pageSize 0 returns no records, and negative pageSize, malformed or non-Int32 values return 400. Offset multiplication uses checked Int64 arithmetic. Queue falls back to its last page when a requested page is empty. Unicode title fallback and quality weights run as scalar SQL functions. Cutoff policy checks and ETA estimates scan compact candidates in batches of 128, retaining only matching ids or numeric sort keys.
x-arr-views.history: GET /history supports repeated or comma-separated eventType values (ids or names), downloadId, movieIds/seriesIds and Sonarr episodeId. IncludeMovie/includeSeries/includeEpisode embed only when requested; imported episode aliases resolve to local episode ids. GET /history/since?date= is an inclusive ascending plain array; /history/movie and /history/series remain complete arrays, with series seasonNumber filtering. Filtering and ordering run in SQL. RefreshMonitoredDownloads shares one global poll job across views and deduplicates for 30 seconds, including after completion or failure and across restarts.
x-arr-views.movieIntake: Radarr views expose GET/PUT /collection (and /collection/{tmdbId}), GET/POST/PUT /importlist, GET/PUT/DELETE /importlist/{id}, GET /importlist/schema (TmdbList/TmdbListSettings only), and GET/POST /exclusions with DELETE /exclusions/{tmdbId}. Collection resources include id, tmdbId, title, monitored, qualityProfileId, rootFolderPath, searchOnAdd, minimumAvailability and movies (including missing parts); PUT also accepts collectionIds for bulk updates. Import lists use fields[{name:listId,value:string-or-integer}], enabled, enableAuto, monitor/shouldMonitor (movieOnly, movieAndCollection, none), searchOnAdd, qualityProfileId, rootFolderPath and minimumAvailability. Profiles and roots select Theatarr versions. Both intakes skip exclusions and existing titles; new titles keep minimum availability, which gates add-time and automatic searches. metadata.lists.interval defaults to 24h (minimum 10m).

post.description: Supports initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list and tools/call. Uses API-key/session auth, session CSRF and per-tool API permissions. Origin must match the listener scheme and host. Notifications answer 202 with no body and never execute tools. Tools use native API validation, permissions and confirmations: a refused change carries a token for the caller, sent back as the tool's confirmation_token. api_request reaches any other route under /api/theatarr/v1 (not /auth, /mcp or /events) as the caller. See docs/mcp.md.

403.description: Invalid Origin, missing session CSRF or insufficient endpoint permission. Per-tool permission refusals are MCP tool results.

label.description: The version's name for people: 4K WEB, 4K Remux

quality.description: The current file's quality; for a series, the quality most episode files have. Without see_files, the resolution only (2160p, 1080p) or absent

files.description: Current files (episode files for a series); see_files only, absent when none

providers.description: see_files only: cache codes (rd, ad, tb; a provider of another kind by its key) of the providers that hold a current file now

upgrade_seen.description: Below cutoff, and a better release than the current file has been seen

control.description: What the controls may do for the copy. see_files only

profile.description: see_files only: the library's quality profile

minimum_availability.description: see_files only, movies: the copy's availability rule in force (an explicit choice, else the library's default, else released)

folder.description: see_files only: the title's folder in the library (the library root holding the copy's first active link, plus the first path element below it); absent without a link

CopyCoverage.description: A series copy's episodes, specials left out. missing, monitored and in_flight are absent when 0 and for callers without see_files

missing.description: Aired, monitored in the copy, not held

in_flight.description: Episodes with a download in hand

Acquisition.description: The downloads in hand for a copy or an episode in brief: the most advanced one's stage (blocked first). see_files only

upgrade.description: The copy or episode already has a file

versions.description: Movie libraries; absent means every library each movie is in

changed.description: Library choices written (minimum availability) or series changed (series type)

versions.description: The copies; absent means every copy each title has

home_release.description: Movies: the day it is out at home, YYYY-MM-DD: the earlier of the digital and physical release dates, else the cinema date plus 90 days (what the released minimum availability waits for); absent without dates

acquiring.description: Some copy has a download in hand that is not blocked and is not an upgrade. Sent to every caller, without the download's detail, on rows and on the title page (TitleDetail)

network.description: The series' network (a movie's first production company)

poster.description: Poster URL on this origin (/img/t/{id}/poster/w342?v=<art_hash>); generated art until the real art is fetched

overview.description: TMDb overview, cut to about 300 characters; absent before the first fetch

release_date.description: TMDb release or first air date, YYYY-MM-DD

upgrade_seen.description: Some version below cutoff has a better release seen: the UI says Upgrade found

title_added_at.description: List rows: when the title was added to Theatarr (the title page has created_at)

status.description: The stored status: a movie's announced, inCinemas or released; a series' TMDb status (Returning Series, Ended, Canceled, In Production, Planned, Pilot)

in_cinemas.description: List rows, movies: the first cinema release, YYYY-MM-DD

digital_release.description: List rows, movies: the first digital release, YYYY-MM-DD

physical_release.description: List rows, movies: the first physical release, YYYY-MM-DD

season_count.description: List rows, series: seasons with episodes, specials left out

previous_airing.description: List rows, series: the latest aired episode's day, YYYY-MM-DD

availability.description: Titles per Availability value. Without see_files, upgrade is absent and those titles count as available

items.description: with_file, wanted, filled and cutoff_met are for callers who see files; absent otherwise, and when zero

qualities.description: Titles per current-file quality; without see_files, per resolution (2160p, 1080p, ...), highest first

providers.description: see_files only; absent otherwise. Values are cache codes (rd, ad, tb; a provider of another kind by its key): titles with a current file a provider of that kind holds now, as the provider filter finds them

total.description: Aired or held in the version

below_cutoff.description: Episodes whose file is below the cutoff

upgrade_seen.description: Of them, with a better release seen

quality.description: The quality most files below cutoff have

score.description: see_files only: the format score most files below cutoff have

in_flight.description: Episodes with a download in hand; see_files only

stages.description: Episodes in flight per acquisition stage; see_files only

next_search_at.description: From when the season's next automatic search in the version may start, the earliest time its Wanted rows give (now or earlier: due). Absent when Wanted gives the season no time, as for a movie copy

next_search_why.description: Why that search is early: asked, added, new or a failure reason; absent on the regular schedule

aired.description: The air instant has passed; without an instant, air_date is today (UTC) or earlier

release_group.description: see_files only; a Theatarr link's from its file metadata

cached_on.description: see_files only: cache codes (rd, ad, tb) of the providers that hold the episode's link's content now

upgrade_seen.description: Below cutoff, and a better release than its file has been seen

note.description: The row's line about the title

date.description: The day the note is about, YYYY-MM-DD (for recent: the server's local day)

at.description: recent only: the moment behind date, so a client can show the day in its own time zone

more.description: An app path that lists the whole row, every kind (/discover/{row})

TitleMeta.description: A title's TMDb metadata (title_meta), filled by the meta.art job

status.description: Movies: announced, inCinemas or released from refreshed canonical release dates; series: TMDb status

release_date.description: Release date (movies) or first air date (series), YYYY-MM-DD

logo.description: Logo URL on this origin, when there is a logo

art_hash.description: Short hash of the art paths, the ?v= of image URLs

release_dates.description: Imported and refreshed TMDb dates; country empty holds canonical theatrical, digital and physical dates, country codes retain TMDb release details

meta.description: Null before the meta.art job first tried the title

franchises.description: Anime franchises that map into the title (GET /anime/franchises/{slug} has the orders)

series_type.description: Series: the type in force (the stored one, else anime for an anime title, else standard)

source.description: The arr instance that owns the version's state

label.description: Title page only: the version's name for people

providers.description: Title page, see_files only: the provider keys that hold a current file now (listed on the account and downloaded there), an adopted link's file found through the hash it stores

cached_on.description: Title page, see_files only: providers as cache codes (rd, ad, tb; a provider of another kind by its key), the codes list rows and releases carry

removed.description: Title page: the copy was removed from the library (its rows and links stay); it counts in none of the title's rollups (availability, size, added). Sent to every caller; absent when false

episodes.description: Title page, series: episodes outside the specials

history.description: Title page: newest first, at most 50

minimum_availability.description: Title page, movies: the minimum availability in force in this library: the explicit choice, else the imported value (which may be tba), else the library's minimum_availability, else released

anime_skip.description: Title page, series: true for a monitored copy in a library searches run for (mode active, grab and the router on) that acquisition does not search, because the library's anime rule does not fit the series (anime by its flag or its type); absent otherwise

CurrentFile.description: A version's current file in brief (for a series, its episode files together). Without see_files, only the resolution as quality (2160p, 1080p), languages and edition. copies.description: see_files only: the copies of the file's torrent to other providers (Add to other providers), one per provider; absent when none

upgrades.description: False when the profile allows no upgrades

from.description: see_files only: the arr instance, or policy

UpgradeNext.description: The best release seen that would replace the file: what Theatarr would take next

SourceCeiling.description: Display only. Confidence, evidence, per-indexer search coverage and overrides are returned only to managers/admins with see_files. TMDb evidence expires within six months. No search or grab behaviour changes.

UpgradeInfo.description: A version's (or one episode's) file against its cutoff. upgrade_available only when a release accepted as an upgrade over the current file was seen after the file: in the newest search that covered it, or an RSS sighting after that search

seen.description: Series: of them, with a better release seen

last_search.description: see_files only: the newest search that covered the file

effective_cutoff.description: Display-only cutoff quality/group in the version profile; manage and see_files only

VersionControl.description: What the title page's controls may do for a version

live_releases.description: The releases panel may search the indexers (mode active)

next_search_at.description: A movie copy: from when its next automatic search may start, the earliest time its Wanted rows give (now or earlier: due, also for an item the next full round takes). Absent when Wanted gives no time: not Live, not monitored, at its cutoff, not scheduled, a download in flight, or paused

next_search_why.description: Why that search is early: asked, added, new or a failure reason; absent on the regular schedule

versions.description: Absent: every version of the title

link_id.description: Theatarr's link holding the episode (absent for an arr's file): the target of POST /links/{id}/episodes

cached_on.description: Cache codes (rd, ad, tb) of the providers that hold the file's content now

info_hash.description: The torrent the file's content came from, when known

copies.description: see_files only: the copies of the file's torrent to other providers (Add to other providers), one per provider; absent when none

journal.description: see_files only: the journal's entries about the episode, newest first, at most 20

event.description: not_started: a download never tried because downloads were off when its turn came (reason says why, in Activity's words); failed otherwise

source.description: see_files only: the arr instance, or theatarr

info_hash.description: see_files only; a searched event: the first release it grabbed

trigger.description: What started the grab or search, in plain words: automatic search, RSS, manual search, manual grab by a person, approved upgrade, Seerr request, an arr

provider.description: Theatarr's grabbed and failed events, and a searched event that grabbed: the provider key

reason.description: A failed event: the failure's short reason

accepted.description: A searched event: its accepted releases

summary.description: A searched event: what it grabbed in one line (Grabbed #1 via rd → imported), or Nothing grabbed: why

latest.description: A searched event whose results the releases view shows (the version's newest decision)

ReleaseOutcome.description: What came of one release for the version: its newest download, and whether its file is the version's current one

replaced_by.description: replaced: the release that replaced it, when the version has one current release

release_title.description: The grab's release title, from history

started_at.description: When the current (or last) run was claimed; absent for a job never claimed, or claimed before this was recorded

retry_of.description: The failed job this one re-runs

retried_as.description: The newest job that re-runs this one

resolved_by.description: Failed jobs: the first later done job of the same kind with the same payload or payload {}

attention.description: Failed, and not resolved, retried or dismissed

counts.description: Jobs per state (queued, running, done, failed) and attention: the failed jobs that still need attention

component.description: Logger component, route pattern, job kind, health check or goroutine

message.description: Normalized message (numbers, ids, paths, URLs and quoted text replaced), the grouping key

sample.description: The latest message as it happened, redacted, at most 1 KB

stack.description: Panics: the goroutine stack, at most 16 KB. Left out of lists

regressions.description: Times it came back after being resolved

subject.description: budget:<key>, indexer:<key>, provider:<key>, metadata:<key> or client:<key>

mode.description: No egress section: off. Empty require_vpn_for: monitor-only. Otherwise required for the listed classes (default indexers).

type.description: Present when the guard is off; readiness still succeeds.

message.description: VPN guard off when no egress section is configured.

next_refresh.description: When automatic builds rebuild it (built_at + metadata.anime.refresh_interval); null while they are off or a refresh waits for review

job.description: The latest anime_build job for the franchise

slug.description: The franchise the job builds, when known before discovery

ready.description: The anime sources are configured, so builds can run

outcome.description: The last discovery; absent when never tried

source.description: Why the item is here: release date, TVDB airs, AniList chain, or the override

entry.description: The AniList entry; absent for refresh_shrink

options.description: conflict and heuristic: the proposed mapping first, then each other candidate

refresh.description: Open held refresh only: what it changes, from the importable mappings in use and in the held build (saved review choices applied). refresh_shrink: series, before, after, lost; refresh_moves_linked: from (absent: no importable mapping now), to (absent: maps to nothing importable), with_files

title_id.description: The Theatarr series with this TVDB id; absent when there is none

id.description: Theatarr's episode id (link to /title/{title_id}?tab=episodes&episode={id}); absent when the episode is not in the title's episode list

name.description: Empty when Theatarr's episode list lacks it

lost.description: Up to five episodes mapped now that the refresh would unmap

items.description: Open held-refresh items of the franchise; one answer settles them all

candidate.description: Index into mapping.candidates; absent for the proposed mapping

title_id.description: The Theatarr series with this TVDB id; absent when there is none

id.description: Theatarr's episode id (link to /title/{title_id}?tab=episodes&episode={id}); absent when the episode is not in the title's episode list

name.description: Empty when Theatarr's episode list lacks it

samples.description: The first two and the last episode of the range

dropped.description: Why the candidate cannot be used

last_add_at.description: When the last add was sent; pacing.min_gap counts from it

hold_level.description: Account-hold cooldown step: 0 (5 min), 1 (15 min), 2 (60 min)

boot_id.description: Ring lifetime identifier; send with after. A changed boot resets the cursor, even for an empty ring.

after.description: Next poll cursor, including entries scanned but excluded by filters.

more.description: Drain another page immediately using after and boot_id.

skipped.description: Matching ring entries overwritten since the requested seen cursor; persistent files may still contain them.

seen.description: Matching records scanned in this boot. Send with after and the same level/component filters to count matching overwritten records.

owner_id.description: The owning account; the key carries its permissions

indexer.description: Policy indexer key; empty means unknown

match.description: How the release matched the title (Id, Title, Alias…); absent when it matched none

profile_rank.description: The quality's place among the profile's allowed qualities, best first (1 the best; a group's qualities share a rank); 0 when the profile does not allow it

profile_ranks.description: The number of allowed ranks in the profile

languages_assumed.description: Neither the name nor the indexer gave a language: languages is the title's original language

prefer_seadex.description: The version's prefer_seadex: SeaDex standing ranks before quality

episodes.description: The episodes the release maps to, as S01E02

missing.description: How many of them have no file in the version

existing.description: The version's current file as the decision saw it (a series: the first mapped episode's)

info_hash.description: v1 info hash; the mount folder is found by it

path.description: Release folder, or a folder or file in it, on the mount (as Theatarr reads it, as links carry it, or a symlink into it): the import takes that release folder and only the files under path; a path off the mount is a 400

release.description: Release title (default the base name of path)

episodes.description: Limits a series import to these episodes; with path naming one file, that file's episodes

files.description: The only files imported, each with the client's episodes (one release folder)

plan.description: library.Plan: download_id, release, version, folder, waiting, files, links, rejected, unmatched, held, dry_run, refused, naming

refused.description: Why the library's gate refused writes

title_id.description: The title the reference belongs to (absent for a scanned link)

titles.description: The distinct titles all its references belong to

copies.description: The torrent's copies to other providers (Add to other providers); absent when none

ProviderCopy.description: One copy of a torrent to another provider (Add to other providers). state: queued, adding and checking are unfinished; added (the provider holds it complete; Cached on shows it), not_cached, refused, skipped and failed are final. message says why in plain words

code.description: The provider's cache code (rd, ad, tb), as Cached on shows it

until.description: When the hold that skipped or failed the copy ends; shown in the browser's zone

copies.description: One per configured provider that did not hold the torrent complete

version.description: The library (version key) whose file to add

episode_id.description: A series: the episode whose file to add

limit.description: How many torrents the account may hold (AllDebrid magnet_limit, default 5000); absent when none is known. Report only

TorrentBackup.description: Theatarr's backup (format theatarr-torrents-backup), or with format=dmm an array of {filename, hash}

provider.description: Only this account's list in the backup

target.description: Restore to this account (default: where each list came from)

action.description: resume: the target holds the torrent an earlier restore added, whose file selection did not finish; the restore selects its files

selection.description: How a provider that waits for a file selection (Real-Debrid) gets one: files, the backup's selection matched by path (on Real-Debrid, still uncached after cached_grace: the restore's own add is deleted and the torrent added once more with every playable file, and the item then says all); all, every playable file (the backup never read the files; never the nfo, text, images or subtitles; none playable: added and left for the person, outcome incomplete); unknown, the backup knows no selection: added and left for the person to select (outcome incomplete)

backup_id.description: The backup taken before the delete

zurg_streams.description: zurg's open streams (/stats); managers and admins

buffering_events.description: changes to buffering in the last 10 minutes

fetch.description: the mount's fetch of the file (rclone rc core/stats), while its cache downloads it; managers and admins

ratio.description: fetch speed over the media bitrate

prewarm.description: the next-episode pre-warm; managers and admins

progress.description: the caching read's share done, 0 to 1

detail.description: what points at the cause; managers and admins

matched.description: link, content, zurg or empty (not found)
